description: Intent-retrieval regression cases for the Effect 4 capability catalog. Each case also acts as a primitive-selection rubric for periodic LLM evaluations.

cases.query: model interruptible asynchronous work with typed failures and dependencies
forbidden: use async await throughout domain services

cases.query: wrap a Promise API and map rejected promises to a typed error
forbidden: let rejection become an untyped defect

cases.query: close a resource reliably when the fiber is interrupted
forbidden: return the resource after its Scope closes

cases.query: start background work that stops when its component shuts down
forbidden: forkDetach without owner-aware shutdown

cases.query: define an injectable business service with a test substitute
forbidden: hide the service in a global singleton

cases.query: provide a default fiber-local setting that callers may override
forbidden: use a scoped resource service

cases.query: compose service implementations into one dependency graph
forbidden: provide every dependency at every call site

cases.query: provide a connection pool as an application-lifetime service
forbidden: discard the finalizer

cases.query: reuse Effect services from event callbacks in a non Effect framework
forbidden: build a runtime for every callback

cases.query: run an Effect program that needs my Layers from an Express route handler without rebuilding the runtime per request and forward the request cancellation
forbidden: create a new runtime inside every route handler

cases.query: represent expected absence when no explanation is needed
forbidden: invent an exception for absence

cases.query: return a pure synchronous success or typed failure value
forbidden: introduce Effect when there is no effect

cases.query: inspect typed failures defects and interruption together
forbidden: discard the Cause before diagnostics

cases.query: wait for one value that another fiber will complete exactly once
forbidden: poll a Ref in a loop

cases.query: pause many fibers behind a reusable open close gate
forbidden: use Deferred when the gate must close again

cases.query: bounded producer consumer mailbox with backpressure
forbidden: use an unbounded array as a queue

cases.query: broadcast every new event to all active subscribers
forbidden: use Queue when every subscriber must receive each value

cases.query: guard a critical section with a mutex or permit count
forbidden: implement locking with a boolean Ref

cases.query: process one finite array with at most eight operations in parallel
forbidden: use unbounded concurrency

cases.query: reuse a bounded set of expensive acquired objects
forbidden: use a Semaphore when objects themselves need acquisition

cases.query: atomically update one pure in memory counter
forbidden: use STM for a single pure cell without composition

cases.query: serialize effectful updates to one shared state cell
forbidden: perform Effects inside Ref.update

cases.query: read current state and stream all later changes
forbidden: lose the current snapshot

cases.query: atomically change several in memory values and retry on a condition
forbidden: call external HTTP inside a transaction

cases.query: incrementally process a large or infinite effectful sequence with backpressure
forbidden: collect the entire input before processing

cases.query: build a reusable consumer that folds stream input and can leave leftovers
forbidden: drop to Channel for a simple fold

cases.query: implement a low level typed bidirectional streaming protocol
forbidden: use Channel for an ordinary map

cases.query: transform a small finite pure collection already in memory
forbidden: introduce Stream without effects or incremental demand

cases.query: retry only transient typed failures with exponential backoff
forbidden: retry every defect and permanent error

cases.query: repeat a successful effect on a cadence
forbidden: use retry to repeat successes

cases.query: poll until a returned value satisfies a condition
forbidden: write a manual sleep loop

cases.query: run an in process cron job on a calendar schedule
forbidden: claim an in process cron survives restart

cases.query: memoize an effectful lookup with TTL and deduplicate concurrent misses
forbidden: assume refresh calls are deduplicated

cases.query: cache keyed scoped resources and finalize them on eviction
forbidden: put live resources in an ordinary Cache

cases.query: serve the current value while refreshing it periodically in the background
forbidden: claim failed refresh discards the last good value

cases.query: batch and deduplicate many keyed requests in one request window
forbidden: issue one remote call per requested key

cases.query: validate unknown JSON at an application boundary
forbidden: cast unknown input to a domain type

cases.query: transform a wire string into a validated domain value and encode it back
forbidden: confuse Schema Type with Encoded

cases.query: define a schema backed domain class with generated constructor and codec
forbidden: annotate away the concrete schema type

cases.query: model a recoverable tagged domain error in the Effect error channel
forbidden: throw a global Error for an expected failure

cases.query: make an outbound HTTP request with middleware retries and decoded response
forbidden: use HttpApi to call an untyped external endpoint

cases.query: route low level HTTP requests without defining a contract first
forbidden: build an HttpApi when dynamic routing is the goal

cases.query: share a typed HTTP contract between server client OpenAPI and middleware
forbidden: duplicate request schemas in router and client

cases.query: invoke typed operations over a transport with streaming and middleware
forbidden: use RPC when public REST semantics are required

cases.query: run parameterized SQL in a transaction and stream rows
forbidden: interpolate untrusted values into SQL text

cases.query: batch database lookups by key to avoid N plus one queries
forbidden: query once per row

cases.query: persist a schema encoded Effect result and load it after restart
forbidden: treat the store lookup as a pure value

cases.query: cache computed values across a process restart
forbidden: use an in memory Cache for restart durability

cases.query: resume a multi step business process after a crash
forbidden: assume an ordinary Effect survives restart

cases.query: perform an external side effect safely from a durable workflow
forbidden: call nondeterministic I O directly in replayed workflow code

cases.query: address a stateful actor by id across cluster runners
forbidden: assume exactly once message delivery

cases.query: append domain events and rebuild projections from an auditable history
forbidden: use EventLog when only current state is needed

cases.query: build derived frontend state with Effect services hydration and invalidation
forbidden: use a local AtomRef for an async service graph

cases.query: store high frequency local form state in a standalone reactive cell
forbidden: build a registry graph for an isolated hot cell

cases.query: decode nested environment configuration and redact a secret
forbidden: read process env throughout business logic

cases.query: add structured logs traces metrics and graceful exporter flush
forbidden: log secrets or use logs as control flow

cases.query: test retries instantly with virtual time and a test Layer
forbidden: sleep in a unit test

cases.query: call a provider neutral language model with structured output
forbidden: parse unvalidated model JSON by hand

cases.query: let a language model invoke schema validated application tools
forbidden: execute arbitrary model text as code

cases.query: publish typed tools to external agents over MCP stdio or HTTP
forbidden: omit the supported MCP protocol list

cases.query: ask the user to confirm before an MCP tool submits merit proposals, on both session and stateless protocol clients
forbidden: trust an unsigned requestState echoed by the client

cases.query: protect a Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint with OAuth bearer tokens and derive the tenant from token claims
forbidden: forward the client bearer token to downstream APIs

cases.query: choose between caching a value refreshing a singleton and caching scoped resources
forbidden: cache a resource without a finalizer

cases.query: choose current persisted state event history durable orchestration or distributed actors
forbidden: claim exactly once across external side effects

cases.query: classify hundreds of raise justifications into labels with a model and get validated answers
forbidden: parse free-form model text with a regex

cases.query: schema decoding is slow on a hot path can I compile the decoder
forbidden: skip validation for speed

cases.query: set statement_timeout and search_path on every postgres connection in the pool
forbidden: run SET after acquiring each connection by hand

cases.query: npm install effect gave me version 3 how do I install effect 4
forbidden: mix effect and @effect/* package versions

cases.query: my timeout fires but the fetch request keeps running forward the abort signal
forbidden: ignore the AbortSignal passed to tryPromise

cases.query: stop effect work when the http framework request is aborted by a client disconnect
forbidden: call runPromise without passing the request signal

cases.query: collect all validation errors from a batch instead of stopping at the first failure
forbidden: use default fail-fast Effect.all for form validation

cases.query: my connection pool layer is built twice is the layer memoized and shared
forbidden: call Effect.provide with the database layer per request

cases.query: validate all configuration at startup and fail before opening connections
forbidden: read process.env lazily inside request handlers

cases.query: reject unknown properties and report all validation errors when decoding input
forbidden: use the removed preserve excess property option

cases.query: base64 encode an employee token and decode it back to a string with a typed error
forbidden: import the removed Encoding module

cases.query: replace msgpack with a compact schema derived binary encoding for socket frames
forbidden: import the removed Msgpack module

cases.query: parse a 10 MiB upload size limit from config and format bytes for a log line
forbidden: use the removed FileSystem.MiB helper

cases.query: check whether an ip address falls inside a cidr range for an ssrf allow list
forbidden: compare address strings by prefix

cases.query: property based test that generates inputs from a schema and shrinks failures
forbidden: import FastCheck from effect/testing

cases.query: publish an event only after the database commit without losing it transactional outbox
forbidden: call the message broker inside the transaction

cases.query: durable background job queue that survives restart with retry backoff and dead letters
forbidden: use an in-memory Queue for jobs that must survive restart

cases.query: compute an access token once and reuse it until it expires
forbidden: store the token in a module-level variable

cases.query: should I put the user id in a metric label cardinality and telemetry privacy
forbidden: attach unbounded identifiers as metric attributes

cases.query: code review checklist for a pull request that adds an effect service and layer
forbidden: approve generated code without checking lifetimes and error channels
